project_type: Next.js 16 app-router e-commerce (Kartiva), TypeScript strict, Tailwind v4, Drizzle ORM + Supabase Postgres
build_system: Next.js 16.4.2 with turbopack. CRITICAL: Tailwind uses @import 'tailwindcss' NOT @tailwind directives. CSS variables defined in globals.css with oklch. No tailwind.config.ts — configured via @theme inline in CSS.
test_framework: vitest (no UI tests required for this task)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` from c:\E-Commerce — must complete without TypeScript errors. 2. Run `npm run dev` and manually verify pages render. No new tests required.
snapshot_or_generated_files: TypeScript global types (PageProps, LayoutProps) are generated by `next dev` or `next build` — run build to regenerate after adding new routes.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. All commands run from c:\E-Commerce. Do NOT use JSX in .ts files — use .tsx. Do NOT import from 'tailwindcss/...' — use @/ aliases. The `cn` utility is imported from 'cn' package (not '@/lib/utils') in some ui components — match the button.tsx pattern which uses 'cn' directly.
contribution_requirements: No new DB schema. No new tests. Mobile-first. All paths use @/ alias. Server components for data fetching; 'use client' only where interaction needed. params and searchParams are Promises in Next.js 16 — must await them.
key_patterns: 1. Button imports from @base-ui/react/button — NOT standard HTML button or shadcn default. All installed shadcn components will follow this @base-ui pattern. 2. Server actions return ApiResponse<T> = {success:true,data:T} | {success:false,error:string,fieldErrors?:...}. 3. getUser() returns Supabase User|null; requireAuth() redirects to /login. 4. Middleware protects /account/* and /admin/* — (auth) and (dashboard) route groups for storefront use /account prefix per middleware (change needed: storefront uses /account but middleware uses /account, so (dashboard) pages must be at /account/... paths). 5. No react-hook-form in package.json — forms use FormData + server actions or useState. 6. @react-pdf/renderer 4.9.0 is installed. 7. lucide-react 1.58.0 installed. 8. Product images are string[] in jsonb. 9. Order status enum: pending, confirmed, processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunded, returned. 10. ShippingAddress in checkout is typed in types/checkout.ts. 11. ProductWithVariants type is in services/product.service.ts. 12. The (auth) and (dashboard) directories in app/ currently only have .gitkeep files.
directory_structure: c:\E-Commerce is workspace root. app/ = Next.js app router. app/(auth)/ = auth pages (currently empty). app/(dashboard)/ = account pages (currently empty). app/api/ = API routes (payments, categories, products, inngest). components/ui/ = shadcn ui (only button.tsx exists). actions/ = server actions. services/ = business logic. db/schema/ = Drizzle schema. lib/ = utilities, auth, validations, invoice. types/ = TS types. config/ = site config.
